description: Platform adapter duplication budget baseline (ADR 0020). Lists duplicated patterns across platform backends that are allowed (consolidation deferred) and those that must be consolidated into moui/backend/shared_adapter.

allowlist.reason: Each platform slot model differs (Android SurfaceView, iOS CAMetalLayer, macOS NSView, Linux X11/Wayland, Windows HWND). The loop structure is uniform but the slot interaction is platform-private. Deferred to shared_adapter pattern extraction.
Per-platform resolution path (macOS windowDidResize, Linux configure event, Windows WM_SIZE) requires native handles. The routing contract is stable; duplication is structural.
Each backend has a unique event loop (NSApplication, X11, Win32, Android Looper, HarmonyOS XComponent). The call pattern is identical but the dispatch harness is platform-private.

Platform variations exist in sync vs async frame application and platform-view composition (Linux offscreen webview, iOS vs Android surface flip). Shared adapter captures the uniform parts; platform-specific finish is allowed.

allowlist.pattern: Texture native surface creation (mtl_texture, vulkan_image, egl_surface)
allowlist.reason: Each platform uses a different GPU API to create render-target textures. This is inherently platform-specific and cannot be abstracted.

allowlist.pattern: Discrete GPU enumeration and Metal/Vulkan/EGL device setup
allowlist.reason: Per-platform GPU backend selection (Metal device, Vulkan instance+device, EGL display) is inherently platform-specific.

rules: Platform backends MUST NOT reimplement make_surface_metrics or normalize_pointer_position — use shared_adapter versions.
New platform backends MUST import moui/backend/shared_adapter and use its transformers where applicable.
Platform-specific WindowEvent dispatch (pointer, keyboard, IME, drag) MUST remain in the platform backend — those carry platform-specific payloads that cannot be abstracted.

Render lifecycle helpers (drain prior present, resolve pending frame, record presented frame) belong in moui/runtime or moui/render, NOT shared_adapter — shared_adapter imports core + backend/host contracts only (ADR 0020).
